x: Has got his O.C. interested in running and brought a team to Mitcham for Joe Bink's last relay. Stan Blunden, now in Hampshire doing his P.T. with Sergt.
He has been supported by Frank Simmons, Stan Blunden, and our Captain. Jack Quarton has also lent his assistance in this event in addition to the Shot and Discus.

Stan Blunden ran well to win the 220 Yards, and our representatives for the 440 were Alf Shaw and Les Cohen! George Powell had a field day in winning three field events, while young Hendry showed the results of Charlie Jones' careful coaching in clearing his highest jump of the season.
We all hope that we shall be seeing you in some of the London fixtures again. Stan Blunden is now up at Kidderminster (Worcs.) and has become a proud father.
Stan Blunden writes from Kidderminster to say that he had a fairly good track season last year. Is hoping to see the lads when they are competing in the Midlands.
